FactorialAPIKeyCredential.title: Factorial API Key
FactorialAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: For internal workflows in your own company, paste an API key from Factorial: Configuration → API → Create API Key. A company administrator must create it. Keys grant full company access and do not expire. Factorial requires OAuth for marketplace integrations.

updated_at_gteq.description: Filter employees by their latest update timestamp (`updated_at`), on or after this date. Only the date is considered; any time component is ignored (matching starts at 00:00:00 of the given date). Note: `updated_at` only stores the most recent update, so an employee updated multiple times is matched solely by its latest update, not by earlier ones.
updated_at_gteq.title: Updated At Gteq

only_active.description: Set to true to keep only the employees not terminated as of today: those with no termination date, or one still in the future. Passing false has no effect, and it is ignored altogether when `include_active_and_terminated` is set.

only_managers.description: Set to true to return only the employees who have at least one direct report. Passing false has no effect.

payable.description: Set to true for the leave types that are paid, false for the unpaid ones. Leave it unset to get both.

employee_id.description: Return only the leave types the time-off policy in force for this employee grants. It REQUIRES `reference_date`, which says on which date to resolve that policy: without it the read raises.

to.description: Return only the leaves that had already started by this date (start date on or before it). Usable on its own; pair it with `from` for a window.
to.title: To

from_date.description: Return only the leaves that had not finished before this date, meaning they end on or after it or have no end date at all. Usable on its own; pair it with `to` for a window.
from_date.title: From

include_deleted_leaves.description: Whether to include deleted leaves (not included by default if not specified)

approved.description: Set to true for leaves that were approved, false for leaves that were rejected. Leave it unset for every leave whatever its decision. Combining `approved: true` with `include_pending: true` returns approved and still-pending leaves together.
approved.title: Approved

include_pending.description: Set to true to include leaves still awaiting a decision. On its own it returns ONLY the pending ones; alongside `approved: true` it returns approved and pending together.
include_pending.title: Include Pending
